findings.title: Terms of Service not confirmed
findings.description: Launch page/app has no confirmed terms or usage scope.
findings.recommendation: Publish clear terms covering scanner/sale scope, user responsibilities, refunds, prohibited use, and liability limits.

findings.title: Privacy policy gap
findings.description: Personal or project contact data may be collected without a confirmed privacy policy.
findings.recommendation: Publish privacy policy with data collection, retention, deletion, processors, and contact details.

findings.title: Data deletion/export flow missing
findings.description: User personal data collection needs a deletion/export request workflow.
findings.recommendation: Add account/data deletion request flow and document retention period.

findings.title: Cookie/analytics consent not confirmed
findings.description: EU/GDPR readiness may require consent or legitimate interest review for cookies/analytics.
findings.recommendation: Review cookie use and add consent/notice where needed.

findings.title: GST invoice flow not confirmed
findings.description: INR paid plans should have invoice/GST handling before serious launch.
findings.recommendation: Add GST fields, invoice numbering, payment receipt, and accountant review.

findings.title: Crypto/Web3 risk disclosure missing
findings.description: Users may mistake readiness report as investment/audit guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Add no-investment-advice, no-certified-audit, no-100%-security, and crypto-risk disclosure.

findings.title: Refund/scope policy not confirmed
findings.description: Paid manual review packages need scope and refund clarity.
findings.recommendation: Publish scope/refund policy that separates automated scan, manual review, and out-of-scope work.

findings.title: Incident response process missing
findings.description: Security product or Web3 launch needs clear incident contact and escalation flow.
findings.recommendation: Add incident response contact, severity triage, response time targets, and disclosure process.

findings.title: Safe harbor not confirmed
findings.description: If researchers report issues, lack of safe harbor creates trust and legal ambiguity.
findings.recommendation: Publish responsible disclosure/safe harbor language.
